title: Refinement of finite subobject filtrations
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $P$ a predicate on its objects invariant under isomorphisms. For an object $F$, let $0=c_0\leq\cdots\leq c_m=F$ be a finite chain of subobjects. Here a subobject is an isomorphism class of monomorphisms into $F$, and $c_{j+1}/c_j$ denotes the cokernel of the induced monomorphism between chosen representatives. Suppose each $c_{j+1}/c_j$ either satisfies $P$ or admits a finite subobject chain from zero to itself with all consecutive cokernels satisfying $P$. Then $F$ admits a finite subobject chain from zero to itself with all consecutive cokernels satisfying $P$. Chains need not be strict, and both outer and inner lengths may be zero.

proof.text: Regard the isomorphism-invariant predicate P as an ObjectProperty. Use the proved declarations filtrationClosure, le_filtrationClosure, and the isomorphism and extension closure instances in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.Extensions. The module contains no sorry.

For a subobject chain whose quotient objects belong to P.filtrationClosure, induct on the natural chain index. At index zero the underlying bottom object is zero via Subobject.botCoeIsoZero. At the successor index, apply prop_X₂_of_shortExact to the canonical short exact sequence for Subobject.ofLE and its cokernel. At the final index transport through Subobject.underlyingIso of the identity. Apply this first to each inner chain and then to the outer chain.

Induct on the constructors of filtrationClosure to construct a Fin-indexed subobject chain. For a zero object use the constant bottom chain of length zero. For of_mono i, map the previous chain by Subobject.map i and append top. Map preserves bottom and order. The underlyingIso of each composite inclusion gives a commuting square of isomorphisms; cokernel.mapIso identifies each old quotient with its mapped quotient. The final quotient is the cokernel of i using the underlyingIso of i and of the identity. Transport P along these isomorphisms. The code proves the needed equality transport and mapped-quotient isomorphisms as private lemmas.

theorem finite_filtration_refinement
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (P : C → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ (A B : C), Nonempty (A ≅ B) → P A → P B)
    (F : C) (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → Subobject F) (hc : Monotone c)
    (hbot : c 0 = ⊥) (htop : c (Fin.last m) = ⊤)
    (hquot : ∀ j : Fin m,
      P (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (c j.castSucc) (c j.succ) (hc j.castSucc_le_succ))) ∨
      ∃ (n : ℕ)
        (d : Fin (n + 1) → Subobject
          (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (c j.castSucc) (c j.succ)
            (hc j.castSucc_le_succ)))) (hd : Monotone d),
        d 0 = ⊥ ∧ d (Fin.last n) = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ k : Fin n, P (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (d k.castSucc) (d k.succ)
          (hd k.castSucc_le_succ)))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin (n + 1) → Subobject F) (hd : Monotone d),
      d 0 = ⊥ ∧ d (Fin.last n) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ k : Fin n, P (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (d k.castSucc) (d k.succ)
        (hd k.castSucc_le_succ)))
